title: Enclosed areas subject to flooding in A-Zones.
officialText: The certificate of occupancy shall describe all wet floodproofed enclosed areas below the design flood elevation as “subject to flooding”. Such wet floodproofed enclosed areas shall be usable solely for parking, storage, building access or crawl spaces.
